name: GBIF (Global Biodiversity Information Facility)
description: Over three billion species occurrence records - a specimen in a museum drawer, a bird logged on eBird, a plant photographed on iNaturalist - each with species, date and coordinates, from more than 2,000 publishing institutions. The single largest open record of where life has been observed.

license.name: per-record: CC0, CC-BY or CC-BY-NC
license.redistribution: honour each record's licence; a download DOI is minted for citation

access.auth_note: searching is anonymous; large downloads need a free GBIF account and are delivered asynchronously with a DOI
access.size_hint: a full-species download can be several GB
access.rate_limit: search API is limited to 100,000 records via paging - past that you must use the download API
access.pagination: offset and limit, offset capped at 100,000

probes.description: Resolve a loose name to the accepted taxon

recipes.title: Occurrences of one species in a bounding box
recipes.code:
KEY=$(curl -s 'https://api.gbif.org/v1/species/match?name=Danaus%20plexippus' | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["usageKey"])')
curl -s "https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/search?taxonKey=$KEY&decimalLatitude=38,40&decimalLongitude=-78,-76&limit=5" | python3 -m json.tool | head -30

gotchas.trap: Paging past 100,000 records silently stops rather than erroring.
gotchas.fix: Use the asynchronous download API for anything larger; it returns a DOI you can cite.

gotchas.trap: Occurrence records include cultivated plants, zoo animals and fossils.
gotchas.fix: Filter on basisOfRecord and establishmentMeans before treating hits as wild observations.

gotchas.trap: Coordinates are often rounded or obscured for endangered species.
